What is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> ?
questions.solution:
In air, oxygen and nitrogen gases are present with which magnesium reacts and the reaction takes place as below: 

Mgs + Air → MgO + Mg3N2                               A           B

B reacts with water to form magnesium hydroxide and ammonia.

Mg3N2 + H2O →MgOH2 + NH3

NH3 acts as a reactant in the manufacture of nitric acid by Ostwald's process.

The atoms of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></math> (anions) form a <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>ccp</mi></math> lattice. The atoms of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></math> (cations) occupy half of the octahedral voids and half of tetrahedral voids. What is the formula of the compound?
questions.solution:
The atoms Y form a CCP lattice means atoms are present at corners as well as the face centre.

So, the number of atoms of Y present in the unit cell =4

Number of tetrahedral voids present in CCP=8

Number of octahedral void present in CCP=4

So, the number of atoms of X present in the unit cell = 12×8 +12×4 = 4+2 =6

So, formula of unit cell : X : Y =6:4 X : Y = 3:2i.e. X3Y2

questions.solution:
Suppose at velocity v,potential energy of body is twice that of kinetic energy.

Using energy conservation-

mgH=KEf+PEf  …1

Since PEf=2×KEf

Put this value in equation 1-

mgH=3×KEf

⇒  mgH=3×12mv2

⇒  v=23gH

⇒  v=102  m s-1

questions.q:
Assertion A : The work done by the electrostatic force is zero when a point charge moves in a circular path around another charge.

Reason R : The dot product of force and displacement vectors gives work done.
options: Both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion.
Both Assertion and Reason are true but Reason is NOT the correct explanation of Assertion.
Assertion is true but Reason is false.
Assertion is false but Reason is true.
questions.solution:
When the force is acting at right angle to the direction of
motion of charge, then the work done is zero.
W=Fdcos90°
W=0
The electrostatic force is radially inwards when a point charge moves in a
circular path around another charge.

Therefore, the electrostatic force acts at right angle to the direction of motion of the charge. Hence, work done is zero.
